task.description:
Verify Zig installation and project usability for this workspace. Check Zig CLI availability and version, verify the executable resolves in shell PATH, and run a project build check to confirm Zig works with this repository.

REWORK ITERATION 1: Previous attempt failed because Zig was discoverable but broken (`unable to find zig installation directory` from the WinGet shim target). Perform Zig reinstall/repair in this environment, ensure the resolved Zig executable points to a valid installation directory, then re-run verification checks (`zig version`, command resolution, and `zig build`).

REWORK ITERATION 2: Change approach. Do NOT repeat WinGet uninstall/install loop. Install Zig from official release archive to a stable local path, rebind command resolution so `zig` resolves to the valid install (or equivalent stable shim), and then re-run `zig version` + `zig build` verification.
acceptance_criteria: Project build command runs and result is captured
Any blocker is documented with actionable issue details

result.summary: Rework iteration 2 completed using official Zig archive extraction into the expected local install path; zig now resolves correctly and project build succeeds.
